activities.instructions: Complete the paragraph with one word.
activities.passage: On Saturday, I visited ___ small market near my flat. I bought bread and fruit for lunch.
activities.prompt: Which article completes the paragraph?
activities.explanation: The market is introduced for the first time, so the indefinite article «a» is appropriate.

activities.instructions: Complete the paragraph with one word.
activities.passage: Our train stopped outside the town, so we waited ___ the next one. It arrived ten minutes later.
activities.prompt: Which preposition completes the paragraph?
activities.explanation: The phrase is «wait for the next one».

activities.instructions: Complete the paragraph with one word.
activities.passage: Lena forgot her umbrella, but her friend lent ___ one before they left the café.
activities.prompt: Which pronoun completes the paragraph?
activities.explanation: The possessive pronoun refers to Lena, so it is «her».

activities.instructions: Complete the paragraph with one word.
activities.passage: The café was full, ___ we took our coffee outside and sat in the square.
activities.prompt: Which linker completes the paragraph?
activities.explanation: «So» links the situation to its result.

activities.instructions: Complete the paragraph with one word.
activities.passage: I made a list before shopping because I did not want to forget ___ important.
activities.prompt: Which word completes the paragraph?
activities.explanation: In a negative sentence, the indefinite pronoun «anything» means any item at all.

activities.instructions: Complete the paragraph with one word.
activities.passage: The library has been closed ___ Monday because workers are painting the main room.
activities.prompt: Which time word completes the paragraph?
activities.explanation: «Since Monday» marks the point when the closure began.

activities.instructions: Complete the paragraph with one word.
activities.passage: The weather forecast predicted heavy rain, ___ we changed the route and stayed near the station.
activities.prompt: Which linker shows the result of the weather change?
activities.explanation: The route change is the result, so use «so».

activities.instructions: Complete the paragraph with one word.
activities.passage: The course is for people ___ want to improve their writing at work.
activities.prompt: Which relative word completes the paragraph?
activities.explanation: «Who» introduces a relative clause about people.

activities.instructions: Complete the paragraph with one word.
activities.passage: We have been preparing the exhibition ___ three weeks, and it opens tomorrow.
activities.prompt: Which time word gives the length of the exhibition preparation?
activities.explanation: «For three weeks» expresses the length of the preparation.

activities.instructions: Complete the paragraph with one word.
activities.passage: The guide told us ___ the museum closes at six, so we entered before five.
activities.prompt: Which reporting word introduces the museum information?
activities.explanation: «That» introduces the reported statement after «told us».

activities.instructions: Complete the paragraph with one word.
activities.passage: Although ___ was getting late, the volunteers continued sorting the donated clothes.
activities.prompt: Which subject completes the paragraph?
activities.explanation: The expression «it was getting late» requires the dummy subject «it».

activities.instructions: Complete the paragraph with one word.
activities.passage: The instructions explain ___ the device works and how to switch it off safely.
activities.prompt: Which question word completes the paragraph?
activities.explanation: «How» introduces an explanation of the method or process.

activities.instructions: Complete the paragraph with one word.
activities.passage: The painting ___ hangs in the entrance was made by a former student.
activities.prompt: Which relative word identifies the entrance painting?
activities.explanation: «That» can introduce a defining relative clause about the painting.

activities.instructions: Complete the paragraph with one word.
activities.passage: I have not spoken to my tutor ___ the end of the course, although I have emailed her.
activities.prompt: Which time word marks the last contact with the tutor?
activities.explanation: «Since the end of the course» gives the starting point for the period.

activities.instructions: Complete the paragraph with one word.
activities.passage: We left early in order ___ find a parking space near the theatre.
activities.prompt: Which infinitive marker completes the paragraph?
activities.explanation: The phrase «in order to» expresses purpose.

activities.instructions: Complete the paragraph with one word.
activities.passage: The lecture was ___ useful that I downloaded the speaker's notes afterwards.
activities.prompt: Which intensifier introduces the lecture's result?
activities.explanation: «So» modifies the adjective «useful» before the result clause.

activities.instructions: Complete the paragraph with one word.
activities.passage: I wish I ___ checked the opening hours before travelling across town.
activities.prompt: Which auxiliary completes the paragraph?
activities.explanation: The speaker regrets a past action, so «wish» takes past perfect «had checked».

activities.instructions: Complete the paragraph with one word.
activities.passage: The centre, ___ doors are painted blue, offers free classes in the evening.
activities.prompt: Which relative determiner completes the paragraph?
activities.explanation: «Whose» connects the centre with its doors.

activities.instructions: Complete the paragraph with one word.
activities.passage: The new timetable is easier to use ___ the old one because the information is grouped by route.
activities.prompt: Which comparison word completes the paragraph?
activities.explanation: Comparatives are followed by «than».

activities.instructions: Complete the paragraph with one word.
activities.passage: The form must be submitted no later ___ Thursday afternoon, or the application will be delayed.
activities.prompt: Which deadline word completes the paragraph?
activities.explanation: The deadline expression is «no later than».

activities.instructions: Complete the paragraph with one word.
activities.passage: By the time the doors opened, the queue ___ already stretched around the building.
activities.prompt: Which auxiliary shows what happened before the doors opened?
activities.explanation: The queue stretched before the doors opened, so past perfect «had stretched» is needed.

activities.instructions: Complete the paragraph with one word.
activities.passage: No sooner had the speaker begun ___ the microphone stopped working.
activities.prompt: Which conjunction completes the paragraph?
activities.explanation: The fixed construction is «no sooner ... than».

activities.instructions: Complete the paragraph with one word.
activities.passage: The new policy applies ___ every member of staff, including temporary workers.
activities.prompt: Which preposition follows the verb apply in this policy notice?
activities.explanation: The verb «apply» is followed by «to» before the affected group.

activities.instructions: Complete the paragraph with one word.
activities.passage: The interviewer asked me where I ___ learned about the vacancy before moving to the next question.
activities.prompt: Which auxiliary belongs in the indirect interview question?
activities.explanation: The learning happened before the interview question, so past perfect «had learned» fits.

activities.instructions: Complete the paragraph with one word.
activities.passage: The guide asked visitors to remain quiet regardless ___ how exciting the demonstration became.
activities.prompt: Which preposition follows regardless during the demonstration?
activities.explanation: The fixed expression is «regardless of».
